purpose: Primary-source calibration and literature for The Network That Learns to Invent. These records are sourcing, not experimental observations.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra Model
sources.author: OpenAI
facts: API model ID gpt-6-astra
Standard short-context input $10, cached input $1, output $50 per million tokens
1,050,000 context tokens; 128,000 maximum output tokens
Reasoning efforts low, medium, high, xhigh, max
Text input/output and image input; Responses tool support includes computer use, shell, code interpreter, functions and MCP
Fine-tuning not supported
limitations: Public documentation does not establish this account's model entitlement or effective rate limits
No live API call was made for this research memo
Published snapshot section exposes gpt-6-astra, not a dated immutable snapshot

sources.title: Pricing

Web search $10 per 1,000 calls plus search-content tokens
Tool tokens are billed at selected model rates
Hosted environment costs are separate from model-token prices
limitations: Rendered pricing page exposes several selectable rate tables; individual model pages specify >272K input full-request uplifts of 2x input/cache and 1.5x output, while an alternate table renders 2x output. Avoid using long-context prices without re-verification
Container table and accompanying per-minute wording are not sufficient for an unambiguous detailed duration assumption

sources.title: Using GPT-6

facts: Describes evaluator-guided evolutionary code improvement and computational application results

sources.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
facts: Pairs a frozen pretrained LLM with systematic program evaluation
Reports new cap-set constructions and improved bin-packing heuristics
limitations: Does not validate the present study's autonomous invention or commercial demand

sources.title: Reduced basis approximation and a posteriori error estimation for affinely parametrized elliptic coercive partial differential equations
sources.journal: Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering
facts: Combines low-dimensional Galerkin projection, greedy sampling, error estimation and offline-online decomposition
Includes heat-conduction and convection-diffusion applications
limitations: Full publisher PDF not retrieved; only institutional abstract inspected
These are established numerical methods, not inventions of this study

sources.title: Model Order Reduction by Proper Orthogonal Decomposition
facts: Reviews POD/SVD, parametric PDE surrogates, error certification, adaptivity and basis updates
limitations: Reference method; not evidence for this artifact's measured accuracy

sources.title: Residual Based Sampling in POD Model Order Reduction of Drift-Diffusion Equations in Parametrized Electrical Networks
facts: Studies adaptive POD construction over parameter ranges for drift-diffusion models
limitations: Different physical/equation setting; cited for residual-guided basis-development precedent, not an equivalent replication

sources.title: Data-Driven Sparse Sensor Placement for Reconstruction
facts: Uses training-derived low-dimensional features, SVD and pivoted QR to select sparse sensors for reconstruction
limitations: Data-dependent sensing can fail under distribution change; no general superiority is inferred

sources.title: Efficient D-optimal design of experiments for infinite-dimensional Bayesian linear inverse problems
facts: Uses low-rank structure for computationally efficient log-determinant experimental-design objectives in PDE inverse problems
Demonstrates a sensor-placement application in a two-dimensional advection-diffusion problem
limitations: D-optimality is conditional on the specified statistical model, design space and computational procedure

sources.title: Goal-Oriented Optimal Design of Experiments for Large-Scale Bayesian Linear Inverse Problems
facts: Targets posterior uncertainty in a downstream quantity of interest rather than only unknown parameters
Includes sensor placement for contaminant-source inference under diffusion and transport
limitations: Changing the design objective must preserve the beneficiary's original required outcome

sources.title: pymor.reductors.coercive
sources.author: pyMOR developers and contributors
facts: Coercive reduced-basis estimator uses residual dual norm
An appropriate lower bound on the coercivity constant is required for a guaranteed error upper bound
limitations: Residual size alone is not a general error certificate

sources.title: scipy.sparse.linalg.cg
sources.author: SciPy community
facts: CG requires Hermitian positive-definite operator and positive-definite preconditioner
Convergence criterion is norm(b-Ax) <= max(rtol*norm(b), atol)
limitations: A small solver residual does not quantify physical model error

sources.title: scipy.sparse.linalg.splu
sources.author: SciPy community
facts: Sparse LU returns a reusable object with a solve method
Uses SuperLU; CSC input is most efficient
limitations: Ordinary within-mission factor reuse belongs in a competent baseline when matrices repeat
